items.name: about-page
items.title: About page
items.description: The site's about and careers page: the head centered with one White button, a strip of photos in front of the band of light drifting slowly, the story at 720px, the benefits (each group's title beside its list) and the footer.
items.use_for: A company's about or careers page. Put your team's photos in `content.photos` (`src` and `alt`; `light` for one of the site's light tiles, `wide` for two columns); edit lib/pages/about.ts or pass `content`.
never: Photos with filters, tints or overlays: as taken
A light that keeps moving with reduced motion
Someone else's team in the strip: your own photos, or the empty tiles
More than one White button in a view
items.source: Site pages/About (AboutPage.tsx, About.module.css) and content/pages/about.ts: the head 128px from the top, the title h3 (h2 from 768) at --measure + 80, the lead 32px under it, the button 56px under that; the strip 96px above and below, seven 120px columns 8px apart on phones (the width, 12px apart, from 768), tiles 4:5 on --surface, the wide one two columns; public/brand/light/hero-band.webp at 120% width drifting 4% over --hero-band-bob-time (14s) on --ease-drift, and tile-b and tile-c; the story 96px below, the benefits 128px below; .t-sub heads, 16/24 text in --text, the group title h6 medium beside its list (240px) from 640
items.body:
`sections` lists the sections to show, in order (`head`, `photos`, `story`, `perks`); a key left out is not shown.
`content.photos` take your team's photos as image slots (`src`, `alt`, `fit`, `position`); an empty tile carries
`data-ds-placeholder`. `menus` passes the header menus (the live card's `picture`, the use cases' `shots`).

items.name: abstract-canvas
items.title: Abstract canvas
items.description: An ASCII drawing in a 14:13 panel on the raised surface: archive rows of a brand's records packing toward the foot, a field of characters resolving into tags, or a brand graph linking clusters of records. It loops while on screen; settled with reduced motion.
items.use_for: The illustration beside a reason on a features or why page: remembering, pre-analysis, one graph.
never: Real brands' names or records: pass Acme's or your own
As a chart people read for numbers: it is an illustration
Moving with reduced motion
items.source: Site abstract/Abstract (ArchiveRows, TagField, BrandGraph), archive.ts, tags.ts, graph.ts, useAbstractCanvas.ts and Abstract.module.css (14:13, --radius-m, --surface); timings --dur-abstract-*, the loop and proof steps; the graph and tags curves from v2/motion

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: A stack of disclosures on Black: neutral hairlines between the rows, a DM Sans question, a muted answer that opens in place and a chevron that turns. One open at a time, or several.
items.use_for: Questions on a pricing or help page, filters a person opens one by one, settings that would crowd a view.
never: Hiding the one thing a person came for: put it on the page
A #262626 card per row: rows are hairlines on Black
A chevron that moves on hover
items.source: Derived from the guidelines: Black ground, neutral hairlines, DM Sans for body text. shadcn's accordion for anatomy, ARIA and keys.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: Alert dialog
items.description: A question that needs an answer before anything else, on the #262626 overlay surface over a Black scrim: a Funnel Display title, one line saying what happens, Cancel and the action (red for what removes something).
items.use_for: Confirming what can't be undone: deleting a board, removing a teammate, canceling a plan. Say exactly what goes away.
never: Confirming what can be undone: do it and offer undo
A scrim that closes it: only a choice does
A vague action label ("OK", "Yes"): name the action ("Delete board")
A shadow around the window
items.source: Derived from the guidelines: the #262626 card fill on Black, neutral hairlines, the 10px canvas corner (8px here), Funnel Display titles, DM Sans lines, the White primary and #262626 secondary buttons. shadcn's alert dialog for anatomy, focus and keys.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: A note or a problem in a #262626 box on Black: a Lucide icon, the subject in DM Sans Medium, a muted line under it and the button that goes with it. Red for what broke.
items.use_for: A plan note, a failed payment, a search that needs a change: one box per message, with the action that settles it.
never: A spectrum color fill or a glow
A border or a shadow around the box
Red for anything that did not break
Several messages in one box
items.source: Derived from the guidelines: the #262626 card fill on Black with the 10px canvas corner (8px here), DM Sans Medium for labels, the brand's voice ("$10 for your first month, then $20/month"). shadcn's alert for anatomy.

items.name: ascii-drift
items.title: ASCII drift
items.description: A crop of the site's ASCII texture tile behind a section, fading out radially from one side: quiet at 0.5, faint at 0.32, or the hero's full strength with a wider core.
items.use_for: A quiet grain at the edge of a hero, a page head or a closing band, behind the content; the classes size and place it inside a positioned section.
never: Over text or a photo: put it at an edge, behind the content
As the main graphic
Moving: the drift is still
items.source: Site ui/AsciiDrift (AsciiDrift.module.css): public/brand/textures/ascii-texture@2x.webp at 1080px, crops mass (-120, -592), column (0, -16), cluster (-336, -248), scatter (-808, -560); a radial mask from 24% (56% for the hero), opacity --ascii-quiet 0.5 or --ascii-faint 0.32

items.name: ascii-lens
items.title: ASCII lens
items.description: A mouse lens over the page's ASCII drifts and textures: near the pointer, the texture's empty cells fill with more characters, denser where the texture is. One per page; it finds the drifts itself.
items.use_for: A marketing page with ASCII drifts, next to the cursor effects in the layout.
never: More than one on a page
On touch or with reduced motion
items.source: Site effect/AsciiLens: the texture tile read at 135 by 68 cells, near and far blurs 1.5 and 4, alpha 0.3, gain 2.5, the shared lens (240px, follow 14, ease 7)

items.name: ascii-texture
items.title: ASCII texture
items.description: The brand's ASCII texture, generated: Geist Mono characters from " .:-=+*#" read off a soft heat map, White at 0.35 opacity on Black. Seeded, with areas kept clear.
items.use_for: A quiet grain behind the light and around the content of a hero, a post or a deck slide, where the light fades out.
never: As the main graphic
Over text, the logo or a photo: keep those areas clear
At full opacity, or in a color
items.source: Brand guidelines page 34 (ASCII texture); Figma page 8: ASCII texture (native) text layers, Geist Mono 13.333px at 1.2, opacity 0.35

items.name: ascii-trail
items.title: ASCII trail
items.description: A mouse leaves a short trail of ASCII characters that fades in 700ms, over one section or, fixed behind it, the whole page. Only for a fine pointer; off on touch and with reduced motion.
items.use_for: A quiet response to the pointer on a page head, a 404 or a coming-soon page, behind the content.
never: Over text people read: it sits behind the content
On touch, or with reduced motion
Two on one page (a page trail and a section trail)
items.source: Site effect/AsciiTrail (AsciiTrail.tsx, trail.ts, AsciiTrail.module.css): 8 by 16 cells from " .:-=+*#", radius --ascii-trail-radius 72px, fade --ascii-trail-fade 700ms, opacity --ascii-trail-opacity 0.35; page mode fixed at z -1

items.name: aspect-ratio
items.title: Aspect ratio
items.description: A box that keeps its shape as it grows: a 1:1 post, a 4:5 ad, a 16:9 slide. It draws nothing itself; the brand corner and a #262626 ground are classes on it.
items.use_for: Creatives in a grid, previews of posts and ads, a video or a slide that must not reflow while it loads.
never: Stretching or cropping a logo to fit the box
Grading or filtering the creative inside: show it as posted
items.source: Derived from the brand assets' canvases (posts 1080x1080, ads 1080x1350, decks 1920x1080). shadcn's aspect ratio for anatomy.

items.name: auth-form
items.title: Auth form
items.description: The site's sign-in and sign-up form in a 400px column: the title and lead, a quiet provider button, the or rule, the email field with its message beside the label, the one White button, the legal line and the way to the other mode; a pressed button shows a spinner until the app takes over.

never: A third-party logo shipped with the library: the provider's mark comes in through `providerIcon` (the `provider-icon` slot)
A second White button
Errors in red: the message is White beside the label and the field's ring turns White

items.name: auth-page
items.title: Sign-in page
items.description: The site's sign-in and sign-up page: Black with the site's own light images in two corners bobbing slowly, two ASCII crops from 1024, the lockup bar, the form centered in the height left, and the proof row of marks under it.
items.use_for: Sign-in and sign-up screens; `mode` picks the copy, `onProvider` and `onEmail` (events in web components) take the presses.
never: A third-party logo shipped in the provider button or the proof row: pass the marks you may show
More than one White button in a view
Real people or customers in the copy: Acme only
Light that keeps moving with reduced motion
items.source: Site app/(auth) and pages/Auth (AuthShell, AuthForm, AuthProof, Auth.module.css): the lights public/brand/light/auth-light-*.webp at min(29vw, 520px) (144px, top right only, on phones), 11:16, bobbing 12px over 14s on --ease-drift; ASCII drifts 36% by 44% from 1024; the bar 64/72px with the 20px lockup; main centered with 64px between the form and the proof row, 32px in
items.body: `sections` lists the sections to show, in order (`form`, `proof`); a key left out is not shown.

items.name: automation-run
items.title: Automation run
items.description: The site's automation run: a quote in the section head over a batch of skewed ad cards that rush in along a rising conveyor and keep drifting; a card under the pointer, focus or a tap rises and turns, the cards ahead give way and a note opens with its numbers.
items.use_for: Showing a batch of found ads or posts as the enterprise and templates pages do: what an automation delivered, each card opening its facts.
never: Third-party creatives you may not show: pass your own through `items` (placeholders are neutral gradients)
A customer quote that is not yours to publish
Cards that keep moving with reduced motion
More than about twenty items: the conveyor is sized for a batch
items.source: Site pages/Enterprise (AutomationRun.tsx, AutomationRun.module.css) and content/pages/enterpriseAutomation.ts: --ent-run-* (stage 480, 640 at 768, 800 at 1280; cards 32% then 16% of the width, 14.8deg skew; lift 112, 140, 180px with a 12deg turn on a 400ms spring; drift 15px/s; note 288px, 80ms intent); the note's fade 160ms (site 150ms)
items.body:
`items` takes each ad or post: `brand`, `title`, `alt`, `src` (a still, or the poster of `video`), `video` (a short muted
loop, played only while the run is on screen and the tab visible; with reduced motion it rests on its poster), `tone` (the placeholder's gradient), `facts`, `start` and `end` (YYYY-MM-DD), `post` (`channel`, `views`), `source`
and `media`. The note counts days to `content.reportDay`. The engine (`lib/automation-run.ts`) writes transforms straight
to the cards, runs only while the run is on screen, and holds the batch at rest with reduced motion.

Each item's picture takes `src`, `fit` and `position` (its `alt` is read with the facts); a card or thumb without one
carries `data-ds-placeholder`.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: Who or what something belongs to, in a circle: a picture cropped round, or the name's initials in White DM Sans Medium on #262626. Three sizes.
items.use_for: A board's members, the account in a header, who saved a creative.
never: A real person's photo or name in examples: use Acme
A spectrum color behind the initials
The logomark as an avatar for anything but the brand itself
items.source: Derived from the guidelines: the neutral steps (#262626 fill), White DM Sans Medium labels. shadcn's avatar for anatomy and the image fallback.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: A short label for a state or a kind, in DM Sans Medium capitals with 6% tracking: White, #262626, a hairline, or a red wash. A small spectrum dot can lead it.
items.use_for: A creative's format or status, a plan's "New", a count beside a tab.
never: A spectrum color as the badge's fill: a dot is as far as color goes
Color alone for the meaning: the word says it
More than one White badge in a group
Sentences in a badge
items.source: Derived from the guidelines: labels in DM Sans Medium capitals at 6%, Black and White first, spectrum colors as small accents only. shadcn's badge for variants.

items.name: bento-block
items.title: Bento block
items.description: Features as a bento grid: #262626 cards with the 4px corner, a title and a line, some wide or tall, an optional picture.
items.use_for: A features section with a few lead features and smaller ones around them.
never: More than one picture per card
Cards in a spectrum color
items.source: Built from the site's feature cards (V2Features: --surface cards, --radius-s, 24px in, h5 titles) on a six-column grid

items.title: Blog page

More than one White button in a section
Another brand's photo as a post image

items.name: blog-post-page
items.title: Blog post page
items.description: A blog post template, built only from library items: the way back, the title in Funnel Display, a wide image, the body in a 720px column (paragraphs, subheads, a list, a quote, a figure of creatives), more posts and the offer.

More than one White button in a section
A body wider than 720px

`sections` lists the sections to show, in order (`head`, `cover`, `body`, `related`, `offer`); a key left out is not

items.name: brand-light
items.title: Brand light
items.description: The brand pattern, generated: one shape drawn three times in Red #DF0000 (0.85), Green #00FF29 (0.782) and Blue #1B1DFF (0.782), each shifted sideways, blurred and blended plus-lighter on Black. Seeded, in every variant the brand assets use.
items.use_for: Behind a hero, along a section's edge, beside a photo or under a search bar: a band, a field, a corner flow, strips down the sides, a tile, a close-up or a curved strip. A main mass and a smaller counterpart elsewhere.
never: Boxed in with hard edges in the middle of a layout: it flows in from edges and corners
On any ground but Black
As a screenshot or an image file: draw it from the generator
Recolored, or animated in a loop
items.source: Brand guidelines page 33 (Brand pattern); Figma page 8: Heat map (slide 1 light), Light R, G and B layers (opacity 0.85, 0.782, 0.782; offset 1.52% of the heat map's width; blur 7.8 of 2913), and every Light band, field, strip, tile and close-up window
items.body:
`source="brand"` (the default) cuts its windows from the brand's own heat map: seeds 0 up to the number of brand windows
for a variant reproduce the brand assets' windows exactly, and higher seeds move and scale them a little.
`source="generated"` builds a new heat map from the seed, the same way. The same seed draws the same light everywhere:
in React, in the web component, in `spyglass-ds light` and in the image and video templates.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: Where you are, in DM Sans: each step back a muted link that turns White under the pointer, a small chevron between, the page itself in White.
items.use_for: A creative inside a board, a setting inside a section: two or more levels deep.
never: A breadcrumb on a page one level deep
Spectrum colors for the links
Icons that move on hover
items.source: Derived from the guidelines: DM Sans for UI text, White on Black with neutral muted steps. shadcn's breadcrumb for anatomy and aria-current.

items.name: browser-frame
items.title: Browser frame
items.description: The site's browser window around a screenshot or a live part of a page: a #262626 window with a #4D4D4D hairline, three gray dots, the address in a small pill, and an optional footer row.
items.use_for: Showing a product page, a dashboard or a result inside a page or an asset, as the site frames its own screens.
never: Colored window dots: they are #666666 on the site
A drop shadow or a glow around the window
Another company's site in the address
items.source: Site ui/BrowserFrame (BrowserFrame.module.css): 28px bar, 8px dots in --line-strong, the address pill 20px tall in --surface-inset with 12/16 text, the window in --surface with a --line-surface hairline and --radius-m

items.name: button-group
items.title: Button group
items.description: Buttons that belong together, joined into one block: the brand corner on the outer corners only and a 1px Black seam between them. A field with its button, a button with its menu arrow, or a vertical stack.
items.use_for: Paging, a pair of views, save with a choice of board, an email field with its Invite button.
never: Unrelated actions in one group
Two primary buttons in one group
A border around the whole group
items.source: Derived from the guidelines: the brand button (White primary, #262626 secondary, the 10px canvas corner, 8px here) on Black. shadcn's button group for anatomy.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: The site's button: a White fill with a Black DM Sans Medium label for the one main action, the quiet secondary (#1A1A1A in a #363636 ring) for the rest, and a ghost for tools in rows; a White glow follows a mouse inside it. Three sizes and a square icon button.
items.use_for: Any action: search, start a plan, explore the product, save. One primary button per view or asset; the rest secondary or ghost. 40px tall by default, 56px large (and 56px on the 1080 canvas).
never: Two primary buttons in one view
A spectrum color as a button fill
A faded button for "not yet": disabled is a #1A1A1A fill with a #666666 label
A press that scales the button: the site's buttons hold still
An icon that moves on hover, or a size change on hover
items.source: Site globals.css .btn and controls.css (40px, 8px corner, quiet ring, glow); brand assets (Figma page 8): Button, Get 50% off (258x56, radius 10, White fill, Black DM Sans Medium 20px label); Button, Search (136x56); Button, Start Creator for 50% off (504x56)

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: A month to pick a day from: 40px day cells with the 4px corner, the picked day a White fill with a Black figure, today in a neutral hairline ring, the months either side faint. Arrows, Home, End and Page Up and Down move; Enter picks.
items.use_for: Picking a launch day, a flight start or a report's range on a page with room for the month. In a field, use the date picker.
never: A spectrum color for the picked day or today
Animating the change of month: it is pressed many times in a row
A calendar where a typed date would do (a birthday)
items.source: Derived from the guidelines: White on Black for the one choice, neutral hairlines, DM Sans for figures and labels, the 10px canvas corner scaled to the product (4px inside small cells). shadcn's calendar for anatomy, keys and ARIA (a grid with a roving day).

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: The brand's card: a #262626 fill on Black with the brand corner, a Funnel Display title, a line of DM Sans and the body, with actions at the foot. No border, no shadow.
items.use_for: A plan, an offer, a stat or a group of settings set apart from the Black ground. The plan card in the ads is the model.
never: A shadow or a glow around it
A border instead of the fill
A card on a card
items.source: Brand assets (Figma page 8): Card, Creator plan (600x452, #262626, radius 10, 48px in; Creator in Funnel Display 40px at 1.0, DM Sans 24px lines, a 504x56 White button)

items.name: careers-page
items.title: Careers page
items.description: The careers page: the page head with the light, why join as three cards and the open roles as rows under hairlines.
items.use_for: A careers page; roles come through `content`.
never: New colors, shadows or type sizes added to a section: use the items' props
More than one White button in a view
Real people or customers in the copy: Acme only

`sections` lists the sections to show, in order (`hero`, `values`, `roles`); a key left out is not shown. `menus`

items.name: carousel
items.title: Carousel
items.description: Slides in a row on the Black ground, 16px apart, one to three in view, with ghost arrow buttons and the place in tabular figures. Icons that move when the arrows are hovered
Dots in spectrum colors: the place reads in figures
Hiding the only copy of something important on a later slide

A case without a concrete figure
The arrow moving on hover: only the link's color changes

A case without a concrete figure
A second head over the stories: the page head names the page

items.name: case-study-page
items.title: Case study page
items.description: The site's case study: a centered head (breadcrumb, headline, kind and read time), the facts with the products it uses, the lead picture, the opening line over three figures, a pull quote, the sections with a second quote, and the pager to the other studies, with ASCII crops in the margins from 1024.

Another brand's photo as the lead picture without permission: the placeholder stands in
Figures that are not true for the story: they read as facts
items.source: Site app/resources/case-studies/[slug]/page.tsx and pages/CaseStudies (CaseStudyArticle.tsx, CaseStudyPage.module.css): head 80/48px (160/64 from 1024), 24px gaps (32 from 1024), the title at most 880px; the 640px measure; facts 2 then 4 columns, 24/20 gaps, 48px under (64 from 768), underlined links in --line-strong; the cover 16:9 (4:5 under 768) with --radius-m; the lead .t-lead 64px down, figures 48px further over a hairline, h4 values; body 64/96px, the pull quote 32px in on --surface, sections 96px apart with h4 titles (h2 from 1024), paragraphs 24px apart in --text-2, the aside 40px down with a --line-strong rule; the pager 40px tall padding between hairlines; drifts from 1024 beside each band
