items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: The hairline: 1px in the #262626 edge step, across or down. Spyglass separates with a fill or a hairline, never a shadow.
items.use_for: Splitting a card's head from its body, or links in a row. Decorative by default; mark it semantic when it splits content a screen reader should hear as split.
never: A shadow or a thicker rule to separate
A rule where spacing already separates
A colored or glowing line: the spectrum belongs to the light
items.source: Derived from the brand guidelines (no separator in the brand assets): the neutral steps for the hairline

items.name: settings-page
items.title: Settings page
items.description: A settings page: the side rail, profile fields and notification switches on cards, and the save button.
items.use_for: Account or workspace settings; the form posts to `action`.
never: New colors, shadows or type sizes added to a section: use the items' props
More than one White button in a view
Real people or customers in the copy: Acme only
items.source: Built from the library and the site's surfaces (cards on --surface, the rail on --raised, hairlines, the 36px links of the header)
items.body: `sections` lists the sections to show, in order (`profile`, `notifications`, `save`); a key left out is not shown.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: A modal panel at an edge of the screen: the card's #262626 fill with a hairline on its inner edge, a Funnel Display title, the body scrolling on its own and buttons at the foot. It slides in on the drawer curve; Escape closes it at once. The body's edges fade while there is more to scroll.
items.use_for: Details, filters or settings beside what someone is doing: a search's filters, a brand's details. Right is the default; left, top and bottom when the layout asks for it.
never: A short question or a confirmation: use Dialog or Alert Dialog
A shadow or a glow: the fill, the hairline and the scrim set it apart
Two sheets open at once
items.source: Derived from the brand guidelines (no sheet in the brand assets): the plan card's #262626 fill, Funnel Display for its title, the neutral steps for the hairline and the scrim

items.name: side-drifts
items.title: Side drifts
items.description: ASCII drifts at a wide section's sides: from 1440 wide a column crop fades in from the left edge and a mass crop from the right, each 40% of the section's height and as wide as the margin beside the content.
items.use_for: Full-width sections on wide screens, where the content column leaves empty margins; inside a positioned section, behind the content.
never: Inside a card or a narrow column
Over the content: they live in the margins
items.source: Site ui/SideDrifts (SideDrifts.module.css): hidden below 1440; width calc((100vw - --content-max) / 2 - 16px), height 40%, top 8%, 30% or 52%

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: The app's rail: Black with a hairline at its edge, the logo at the top, groups named in capitals, the page you are on in White, the account at the foot. It folds to icons with one button. Its body scrolls with fading edges, so no row is cut off.
items.use_for: The main navigation of the product: search, boards, brands, creators and settings. One per app, at the left.
never: A second level of rows: a page's own sections go in Tabs
A spectrum color for the page you are on: it is White, as the primary button
Animating the fold: it is pressed many times a day
items.source: Derived from the brand guidelines (no app rail in the brand assets): Black ground, DM Sans labels in capitals at 6%, the White primary fill for the current page, the brand corner

items.name: site-footer
items.title: Site footer
items.description: The site's footer: the wordmark across the page in the footer gray with the brand light through it, and a #262626 card rising over its descender with the link columns, the lockup and the legal line.
items.use_for: The foot of a marketing site's pages, as spyglass.so ends. For posts, ads and a plain band use the footer row or the footer block.
never: The wordmark in a spectrum color or White: it is the footer gray, and the light is the only color in it
Links that move on hover, or social icons in color
Real company or customer names in the columns
items.source: Site site/Footer (Footer.tsx, Footer.module.css): card 48px in with a #363636 hairline and the 8px corner, titles Funnel Display 20/24, links DM Sans 16/24 #D4D4D4, six columns from 1280, the wordmark in --grey-wordmark #373737 overlapped by half its descender

items.name: site-header
items.title: Site header
items.description: The site's header: the lockup, the links with their dropdown menus (products beside a live card, use cases beside a picture card, resources beside the docs card with the brand light), the sign-in and the one White key; on phones a sheet that reveals downward with the menus as disclosures. A Black ground and a hairline once the page scrolls.
items.use_for: The top of every website page. `links` entries with `menu` open the products, use cases or resources menu; `menus` carries their content (Acme by default, pictures only through `picture` and `shots`); `hideKeyUntil` holds the key back until a hero's actions scroll under the bar; `variant` centered shows the links from 1024, minimal keeps only the lockup and the key.
never: Two White buttons in the header
Platform logos in the menus: platforms are named in words
People's photos as default pictures: pass your own shots
Menus that animate when opened from the keyboard
Icons that move on hover
items.source: Site site/Header (Header, NavMenus, MenuPanels, ProductsLivePanel, LiveVisual, HeaderKey, HomeLink, NavIcon, ScrollGround, MenuSheet, SheetDisclosure, Header.module.css) and ui/WarmPictures: 64/72px bar in the container, grid 1fr auto 1fr from 1280; links 36px, 16px in, --text-2, --surface under the pointer; panels 24px under the links on --raised in a --line hairline with an 8px corner, 874, 944 and 556px wide, rising 8px from scale 0.96 over --dur (--dur-fast out), opening after 80ms of hover and closing 240ms after the pointer leaves; rows 12px in, a 40px glyph tile, 14/20 Medium names over --text-3 lines; the live card 540px crossfading in 200ms; the strip 32px links over a hairline; the key --control-xs, Get API key under 424px; the sheet a modal dialog clipped open from the bar, 24/28 Funnel Display rows under hairlines, the foot pinned. The library names platforms in words, takes pictures through props, and opens menus at once from the keyboard
items.body:
The menus open on hover, focus or click as on the site; from the keyboard they appear at once with focus on their first
link, arrows move through them and Escape returns focus to their link. The phone sheet is a modal dialog: focus stays
inside it and Escape returns it to the menu button.

In `menus`, a products row's `picture` (a src or an image slot) takes the place of its scene on the live card, and a
use case row's `shots` take srcs or image slots; the glyph and the empty tiles shown without them carry
`data-ds-placeholder`.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: A placeholder in the shape of what is loading: a #1A1A1A block with the brand corner, or a circle, that breathes between full and half opacity. Never a shimmer; still with reduced motion.
items.use_for: Holding the place of a creative card, a row or a chart while it loads, sized to the part it stands for so nothing moves when it lands.
never: A shimmer, a gradient sweep or a spectrum color
A layout that jumps when the content lands: size each block to its part
A skeleton for something that loads in under 300ms
items.source: Derived from the brand guidelines (no loading state in the brand assets): the neutral steps for the block, the brand corner
items.body:
When the picture it holds the place of arrives, pass it as `src` (with `alt`, `fit` and `position`): the block shows it, still,
in the same shape and corner. Without `src` the block carries `data-ds-placeholder`, so a page can be checked for
pictures still to fill.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: A value on a range: a 4px #363636 track, White up to the value, and a White thumb with the small corner. It follows the hand without easing.
items.use_for: A rough value where the range matters more than the digit: how long an ad has run, a share, a budget. Show the value beside it.
never: Exact values a person would rather type: use Input
A round, glowing or growing thumb
Animating the thumb: it follows the hand
items.source: Derived from the brand guidelines (no slider in the brand assets): White for the filled part, the neutral steps for the track, the small corner

items.name: sonner
items.title: Sonner
items.description: The corner where notes from toast() show: the newest in front, two more peeking out above. Pointing at the stack spreads it out and holds their time. A note rises in from below and leaves faster.
items.use_for: Saying something just happened, for a moment: saved to a board, a brand added, a link copied. Mount one Toaster per app and call toast(title, { description, action }) from anywhere.
never: Errors that need an answer: keep them where they happened
What the page already shows
Notes that leave while someone is reading them: the time holds while the stack is pointed at
items.source: Derived from the brand guidelines (no toast in the brand assets): the Toast note, stacked in the corner of Black

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: Work with no known end: a quarter arc in the color around it, White on Black, turning on a #363636 ring at a constant speed. With reduced motion it breathes instead of turning.
items.use_for: A search, a save or a load that takes more than a moment, beside the words that say what is happening or inside the busy button.
never: A spinner where the shape of the content is known: use Skeleton
Progress that can be counted: use Progress
A colored, glowing or spectrum spinner
A blank screen with only a spinner
items.source: Derived from the brand guidelines (no loading state in the brand assets): White on Black, the neutral steps for the ring

items.name: stat-block
items.title: Stat block
items.description: Numbers that say what the product does: Funnel Display figures over a line of DM Sans each, under a hairline or on the #262626 fill, four across.
items.use_for: A section of facts on a home, product or about page. Every figure is true and checkable.
never: Invented, rounded-up or unsourced numbers
Colored figures or icons beside them
More than four numbers in a row
items.source: Derived from the guidelines (voice: concrete numbers) and the card on Black; the figures in the example come from the assets' copy (four networks, a brand added in under a minute, unlimited seats, $10 for the first month)

items.title: Steps block
items.description: How it works in numbered steps under hairlines: the number as a label, a title and a line, side by side from 768.
items.use_for: A setup or how-it-works section of two to four steps.
never: More than four steps in a row
Icons that move
items.source: Built from the site's How it works (HowItWorks: hairline rows, labels in capitals, h5 titles)

items.name: stories-block
items.title: Stories block
items.description: The site's stories section: the section head centered over quotes in #262626 cards (the company's mark or name, the quote in Funnel Display 20/24, the person with a ringed 40px avatar and the role in capitals), three columns from 1024 that line up row by row, two cards in the middle, and an optional row of customer marks over a hairline.

never: A real person's quote, name or photo without their consent: Acme placeholders in templates and examples
Another company's logo shipped in the library: pass the marks you may show
Stars, ratings or a carousel
A filter or tint over a photo

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: On or off, with no words: a #262626 track with a gray thumb when off, White with a Black thumb when on. The thumb slides on the strong ease-out.
items.use_for: A setting that takes effect at once: a digest, an alert, a sharing option. The row beside it says what it turns.
never: On and Off written beside it
A switch with no line saying what it does
A spectrum color for the on state
A choice that waits for a Save button: use a checkbox
items.source: Derived from the brand guidelines (no switch in the brand assets): White as the one primary state, the button's secondary fill, the brand corner

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: Rows of one kind of thing on Black: heads as capital labels in muted DM Sans Medium, cells in DM Sans 14px, a #363636 hairline between rows and the ghost fill under the pointer. Framed, it sits in a hairline box with the brand corner. It scrolls sideways with fading edges inside the frame.
items.use_for: Boards, tracked brands, ads with a few columns to compare. Numbers right-aligned in tabular figures; a total in the footer; a caption under it.
never: A table for one record: use Item or a card
Zebra stripes, colored rows or shadows: the hairline separates
A scroll box a keyboard can't reach: give a framed table a label
Bold heads: labels are Medium in capitals with 6% tracking
items.source: Derived from the brand guidelines (no table in the brand assets): the label style for heads, DM Sans for cells, the neutral steps for hairlines, the plan card's fill for the footer

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Views of one thing, one at a time. The default is a segmented control: a #262626 track, the current view a White block with a Black label. Line tabs sit over a hairline with a 2px White line under the current one.
items.use_for: Two to six views of the same thing: kinds of creative in a search, a board's sections. Arrow keys move between tabs; the panel follows.
never: Actions: use Button
More than six views: use a Select or a menu
Bold or a color on the current tab: the White block or the White line marks it
A sliding or bouncing indicator
items.source: Derived from the brand guidelines (no tabs in the brand assets): the primary button's White fill and Black label for the current view, the plan card's fill for the track, the neutral steps for the hairline

items.name: templates-page
items.title: Templates page
items.description: The site's templates page, from library items: the header, the templates wall as the hero, the automation run, what each template brings back (a centered head over the row fan), the questions, the close with two buttons and the footer.
items.use_for: A page introducing templates or playbooks. Edit lib/pages/templates.ts or pass `content`; `fan` (the `fan` slot in web components) takes your own arrangement of the rows in place of the row fan.
never: Another brand's ads or creators in the wall, the run or the rows: pass your own or keep the placeholders
More than one White button in a section
A schedule or a price the template does not state
items.source: Site app/templates/page.tsx (V2Templates as h1, AutomationRun with templatesPage.run, TemplateCities, V3Faq, PageClose with control null) and pages/TemplatesPage/TemplateCities(.module.css), tokens.css 840-931: the head trimmed at the cap, the lead 16px under it, the rows 48px under (72 at 768), each row padded 16px with 128px under it on phones (136 at 768, 16 from 1024 with 40 between rows), the rows as the row fan sets them (names 32/36, 44/48 at 768 and 64/68 at 1024, cards 72, 96 and 128); copy from content/pages/templates.ts and templatesCities.ts with third-party names left out
items.body:
The wall holds a still frame with reduced motion and the run holds its batch at rest. Each row is a link to its use case
with the template's schedule for assistive tech. The row items are Acme placeholder squares; pass
your own pictures through `content.cities.rows[].items[].src`.

`sections` lists the sections to show, in order (`wall`, `run`, `cities`, `faq`, `close`); a key left out is not
shown. `blocks.wall.pictures` fills the wall, `blocks.run.items` the run, and each city row's items take image slots
(the generated blanks carry `data-ds-placeholder`). `menus` passes the header menus (the live card's `picture`, the
use cases' `shots`).

items.name: templates-wall
items.title: Templates wall
items.description: The site's templates wall: a helix of tiles drifting toward the viewer and turning slowly around the words, the headline over a chip that rolls through the template names on a raised surface stretching to each name, the lead and a quiet status line.
items.use_for: Introducing a set of templates or playbooks: the templates page's first section (`hero`) or a section on the home page. `pictures` fills the tiles with your own creatives; without them the tiles take four neutral tones.
never: Another brand's ads or photos in the tiles: pass your own creatives or keep the neutral tones
A filter, a tint or a glow over the pictures: color as posted
More than one rolling chip in a view
Tiles that keep moving with reduced motion: it holds one still frame
items.source: Site v2/V2Templates (V2Templates, TemplatesWall, TemplatesBoot, templatesMotion.ts, field.ts, V2Templates.module.css) and tokens.css 355-357, 395-414, 605-608: 80 tiles, 74 in the tunnel on phones and 128 from 768, 176x220 at 4px radius, 18.5 a turn, drifting 24px and turning 1.5 degrees a second, fading in over 600ms from 0.92; the head at the section size, the chip padded 12px (16px from 768) on the 72% raised surface, a name every 2400ms rolling 600ms on cubic-bezier(0.85, 0, 0.15, 1); the lead 24/32 medium, the status 14/20; the hero fills the window under the header
items.body:
The tiles keep clear of the words: the engine measures the headline, the chip, the lead and the status and fades any
tile whose edge comes within 32px of them, and lets none reach the section's top or bottom edge. It runs only while
the wall is on screen and the tab is visible. `at` draws the frame at a given time and holds it, for a still.

`pictures` takes srcs or image slots (`fit` becomes the tile's background size, `position` its background position).
Without pictures each tile carries `data-ds-placeholder`.

items.name: testimonial-block
items.title: Testimonial block
items.description: One customer as a section: an optional label in capitals over the testimonial, the headshot beside the words or above them, on Black or on the #262626 fill.
items.use_for: A customer's own words on a home, product or pricing page.
never: A quote written for a customer, or a real person's name without permission
Several testimonials in one block
Stars, ratings or company logos beside the quote
items.source: Built from the library (testimonial); Figma page 8: Ad, Testimonial (the quote, name and role; the Figma's named person and photo are never shipped)
items.body: `image` takes a src or an image slot (`src`, `alt`, `fit`, `position`).

items.name: testimonial
items.title: Testimonial
items.description: The testimonial ad: a 4/5 headshot in the brand corner, the quote in Funnel Display in curly quotes, the name in DM Sans and the role and company in capitals.
items.use_for: One customer's words on a page or in an ad, with their real name, role and photo. Stacked as the ad sets it, or side by side on a wide page.
never: A made-up quote presented as a real customer's
Stars, logos or a card around it
More than one testimonial in view at once
items.source: Figma page 8: Ad, Testimonial (Headshot 464x580 at 64,160; the quote 920 wide at 812; the name at 1010; the role in capitals at 1050)
items.body:
The examples are Acme placeholders: put a real customer's quote, name, `position` and headshot (`image`) in their place.
`image={false}` (React) or `image="false"` leaves the headshot out.

`image` takes a src or an image slot (`src`, `alt`, `fit`, `position`); the placeholder headshot carries
`data-ds-placeholder`.

items.name: text-swap
items.title: Text swap
items.description: A value that changes in place: the old one rises 12px and fades out while the new one rises in from below, in one clipped grid cell, with an optional muted unit and a small badge. Sentences, its companion, keeps each sentence of a line whole on a phone.
items.use_for: A price that follows the billing period, a plan name an estimator picks, a sort label; a hero line that should break between sentences on a phone (Sentences).
never: For text people are reading: only short values that change on a choice
Swapping on a timer: it answers a choice
Moving with reduced motion: the value changes at once
items.source: Site pages/Pricing/Swap (Pricing.module.css .swap, .swapItem, .swapUnit; the tag in the plan badge's look, .badge: White, Black caption 4px by 8px, the small corner): inline-grid, clip margin 4px, 12px rise over --dur-loop-badge on --ease-loop (480ms, the brand's slow step); ui/Sentences (inline-block sentences below 768)

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: Several lines of text, drawn as the input is: a #666666 hairline on Black that turns White on focus, DM Sans, the brand corner. It grows by hand downward.
items.use_for: Text longer than a line: a board brief, a note on a creative, feedback. Label it, and say under it what the text is for.
never: A question to search: use the search bar
A red hairline before anything is wrong
Under 16px on phones (it switches to 16px there)
items.source: Derived from the brand guidelines (no text area in the brand assets): the input's hairline, fill and corner

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: One note, what just happened: the card's #262626 fill, a hairline and the brand corner, a DM Sans Medium title, a muted line, one small White button when there is something to do, and a close button.
items.use_for: The surface of a note: Sonner stacks and times these in a corner. On its own, a note that stays where it is.
never: Errors that need an answer: keep them where they happened
More than one button in a note
A colored fill or an icon in a spectrum color for success
items.source: Derived from the brand guidelines (no toast in the brand assets): the plan card's #262626 fill and corner, DM Sans Medium for the title, the White primary button

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: Toggle Group
items.description: Buttons that stay pressed, side by side on one track with the brand corner. Each pressed one is a White block with Black text. On a narrow screen the track scrolls with fading edges.
items.use_for: Options that are on or off together in a filter row: which formats to show, a grid size. `multiple` for several at once.
never: Views of one thing: use Tabs
Actions: use Button
A spectrum color or a glow on the pressed block
items.source: Derived from the brand guidelines (no segmented control in the brand assets): the input's hairline and corner, White as the one pressed state

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: A button that stays pressed: no fill or a hairline at rest, the primary White with Black text while it is on. Sizes match the button's.
items.use_for: One option that is on or off in a row of filters or tools: video only, saved only, show captions.
never: A setting saved at once: use Switch
A pick of one from several: use Toggle Group or Tabs
A spectrum color for the pressed state
items.source: Derived from the brand guidelines (no toggle in the brand assets): the button's sizes, corner and press, White as the one pressed state

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: A control's name, for icon buttons: a White fill with Black caption text and the small corner. It waits 300ms under the pointer, shows at once on keyboard focus, and the next one in a row shows at once.
items.use_for: Naming icon buttons in a row of tools: save, copy link, download. The button still carries its aria-label.
never: Anything someone needs to read or act on: put it on the page
A tooltip on a button that already shows its label
Showing on touch: a tap presses the button
items.source: Derived from the brand guidelines (no tooltip in the brand assets): White on Black as the brand's type, DM Sans caption size, the small corner

items.name: typography
items.title: Typography
items.description: The brand's type scale as one part. Funnel Display Regular for titles, DM Sans for text, Medium for small and labels, labels in capitals with 6% tracking, Geist Mono for code. Every variant is a type utility from the tokens.
items.use_for: Any text: page and card titles, a lead under a hero, body copy, captions, the capital label over a field or a plan, inline code. Pick the step by role, not by look.
never: A size, weight or line height outside the scale: every step comes from tokens.css
Bold or semibold: Funnel Display and DM Sans run at Regular and Medium only
Capitals anywhere but labels, and labels without the 6% tracking
Funnel Display for body text, or DM Sans for titles
Spectrum colors on text: type is White on Black, muted in the neutral steps
items.source: The type pages of the brand guidelines (Funnel Display, DM Sans) and the sizes measured on the 1080 canvas, scaled to the product (tokens.css header); Geist Mono from the ASCII texture

items.name: use-case-answer
items.title: Use case answer
items.description: One question and the answer that came back, as the site shows it on a use case page: the question in a bubble (or the API request as code), the status, the lead, rows with a creative, a title and detail and a figure, a note and the tools called, on the raised panel.
items.use_for: Showing what one question or one call returns, on a use case or product page. `example` takes the question, the rows and the calls; `mode: "api"` shows the request instead of a bubble.
never: Another brand's ads in the rows: pass your own creatives, or keep the neutral placeholders
Made-up figures presented as real: say they are illustrative in the source line under it
More than one answer per panel
items.source: Site pages/UseCasesPage/UseCaseAnswer (UseCaseAnswer.module.css): --surface panel 16px in (32 from 768) with 24px between parts (32 from 768); the question 12/16px in on --surface-inset, the 20px corner, at most 88%; the request 16px in (24 from 768) on Black, 14/20 mono in --text-2; the rows 16/24 with 12px above and below and a hairline on the surface, the 48px creative 16px from the text, the figure 20/28 with tabular numbers; the note above a hairline; the calls as 14/20 mono chips on --surface-inset
items.body:
The figure column shows only when a row has a figure. In api mode the column heads take the mono face, as field names.

Each picture is an image slot (`src`, `alt`, `fit`, `position`); without `src` it keeps its placeholder, which carries
`data-ds-placeholder`.

items.name: use-case-hero
items.title: Use case hero
items.description: The site's use case hero: the page's name as the head, the line in the soft gray, the actions and who it is for, beside a raised panel edged with the ASCII texture holding a live visual: a chat session answering questions in turn, or a team's own ad library re-sorting itself.
items.use_for: The top of a use case page. `visual="chat"` with `chat` (the session's turns: question, tool call, lead, table rows, pictures) or `visual="build"` with `build` (the library's tiles and sorts); `control` puts a connect menu in the White button's place, which on phones steps aside and turns the quiet button White.
never: Another brand's ads or logos in the pictures: pass your own images, or keep the neutral placeholders
More than one White button: with a control, the White button is left out
Motion that keeps running with reduced motion: the chat shows an answer and the library holds still
Icons moving on hover: the chips change color only
items.source: Site pages/UseCasesPage (UseCaseHero, UseCaseChat and chatClock, BuildHero, their CSS modules) with V2HowItWorks/Session and sessionClock, HeroVideo/reference, humanTyping and loopPacing: the hero at least a screen tall less the header, 64/80px padding (96 at 768, 12 at 1024); 5fr and 7fr columns 48px apart from 1024; the panel 16px in (48 from 1024), 448px wide inside (528 from 1280) on --surface with the texture at 0.5 clearing an ellipse 46% by 50%; the chat's frames at 60 a second, typing at a seeded human rhythm, the first answer held 3.8s and later ones 2.8s; the library's sort every 2.8s after 3.8s, tiles gliding 700ms on --ease-loop, text swapping 500ms
items.body:
The chat's first question shows already answered; then the next one types, sends and is answered, and so on in a loop
while it is on screen. A chip picks a question at once; a pointer over the chat, or focus in it, holds the current
answer. Pictures in the answer are neutral placeholders until you pass `src` (your own creatives); with them the
thumbnails show in the rows, and on phones a strip of them sits under the table.

The chat's pictures and the build's tiles are image slots (`src`, `alt`, `fit`, `position`); placeholders carry
`data-ds-placeholder`.

items.name: use-case-page
items.title: Use case page
items.description: A use case's page as the site sets it: the hero with the connect menu and the chat answering beside it, the proof line over the marks, the scroll story, three stories, the wheel of audiences with the light around its ring, the FAQ, the closing section and the footer.
items.use_for: One page per use case, solution or audience. `content` replaces the copy (lib/pages/use-case.ts); `visual="build"` swaps the chat for the library visual (the site's build your own page).
never: Real customers, quotes or photos in the stories: pass your own with permission, or keep Acme's
Another brand's creative in the hero, the story or the wheel: pass your own images
A second White button beside the connect menu
items.source: Site app/use-cases/[slug]/page.tsx and pages/UseCasesPage/UseCaseDetail.tsx: UseCaseHero, V3Proof, ScrollStory with the primary button and See templates, V3Stories (team layout, no customer row), V2UseCases with DispersionField ring seed 5, V3Faq with the docs button, PageClose, the footer
items.body:
Every section is a library item: `use-case-hero`, `proof-block`, `scroll-story`, `stories-block`, `use-case-wheel`
with `dispersion-field`, `faq-block` and `page-close`. `still` holds the wheel and its light for a still preview.

`sections` lists the sections to show, in order (`hero`, `proof`, `story`, `stories`, `wheel`, `faq`, `close`); a key
left out is not shown. `chat` and `build` carry the hero's pictures, `blocks.story.story` the scroll story's data in
place of its preset and `blocks.wheel.items` the wheel's pictures. `menus` passes the header menus (the live card's
`picture`, the use cases' `shots`).

items.name: use-case-wheel
items.title: Use case wheel
items.description: The site's use cases wheel: the headline inside an ellipse of creatives over a drum of audiences. The pill holds the current audience beside a White arrow link; every 2.4s on screen it turns, a new pair of creatives scaling up at the foot while the others climb the ring (50ms apart, turning away as they rise) and the top pair leaves into the distance.
items.use_for: Showing who a product is for, one audience at a time, linking each to its use case page. `items` takes { key, label, line, href, linkLabel, pairs } with three pairs of creatives each (Acme placeholders by default, or `src` images); `light` puts a light layer behind it and can take the ring's ripple.
never: Another brand's ads shipped in the library: placeholders, or the user's own creatives through `src`
Turning by itself with reduced motion (it crossfades and stays put)
Turning while the pointer or keyboard focus is in the drum
More than one White button in the section
items.source: Site v2/V2UseCases (UseCaseWheel.tsx, skillsMotion.ts, ringLight.ts, V2UseCases.module.css) and tokens.css 355-393 and 659-700: ring 152x216 (300x240 at 768, 384x292 at 1024, 440x332 at 1280; 140 tall under 768), cards 48x64 to 108x144, 3 to 5 slots, 96px below; the drum's 52px rows, a 312px pill 12px in with the 36px arrow; turns every 2400ms over 600ms on cubic-bezier(0.85, 0, 0.15, 1), 50ms stagger, new pair from 0.4 fading in over 500ms after 100ms, crossfade 360ms with reduced motion; the ring hidden under 768
items.body:
With `autoplay` it turns on its own once half the window has reached it, and stops when the tab is hidden. A pointer
resting on another label turns to it; a click queues a turn behind one in progress. The heading is the site's `.t-h1`
(32, 44 at 768, 56 only from 1280: `type-section` held at 44 until then), centered on the ring's middle and at most 480px wide.

Each picture is an image slot (`src`, `alt`, `fit`, `position`); without `src` it keeps its placeholder, which carries
`data-ds-placeholder`.

items.name: use-cases-page
items.title: Use cases page
items.description: The site's use-cases hub: the header, the page head with the ASCII drift, the use cases as linked cards three across (each with three creatives on its Black cover), the closing section with the connect menu, and the footer.
items.use_for: An index of use cases, solutions or audiences, each card linking to its own page. `content` replaces the copy and the cards (lib/pages/use-cases.ts).
never: Another brand's creative on a card: pass your own images as `src` or keep the Acme placeholders
Cards that move on hover
A second White button in the head: the hub has none
items.source: Site app/use-cases/page.tsx and pages/UseCasesPage (UseCaseHub.tsx, UseCaseHub.module.css over Resources.module.css): PageHead with the title and lead, the cards in .container three across from 1024 with the 240px cover, the section padding under them, PageClose, the footer
items.body:
Each card takes `title`, `line`, `meta` (who it is for), `href` and a `cover` of three creatives. The header and footer
read lib/pages/site-chrome.ts.

`sections` lists the sections to show, in order (`head`, `cards`, `close`); a key left out is not shown. The covers'
creatives are image slots. `menus` passes the header menus (the live card's `picture`, the use cases' `shots`).

items.name: why-block
items.title: Why block
items.description: The home's reasons: a centered head and three pictures over their titles and lines, hairlines between, each picture an instrument that plays while half of it is on screen: the archive axis, the pricing meter and ten tools giving way to one.
items.use_for: Saying why in three short reasons, each shown working rather than claimed.
never: More than three reasons
A real advertiser's name or ads without permission: the archive's default is Acme with placeholder creatives
The instruments moving with reduced motion: they rest on one frame
items.source: Site v2/V2Why (V2Why.tsx and .module.css, ArchiveAxis, WhyPricing, WhyCustom; content/v2/why, whyArchive, whyPricing, whyCustom; components/instrument/clock.ts as lib/home/scene.ts, V2Features Demo as lib/home/demo.ts): the 64px head margin (80 at 1024), cards 48px apart in a 640px column, three columns 40px apart at 1280 with hairlines between; 14/13 pictures, 16px in (24 from 768); the loop pacing (2600ms step, 700ms change, 1400ms flick, 500ms row fade) on the loop ease
items.body:
Each picture is an image slot (`src`, `alt`, `fit`, `position`); without `src` it keeps its placeholder, which carries
`data-ds-placeholder`.

items.name: wordmark-glow
items.title: Wordmark glow
items.description: The big wordmark across an area in the footer gray over a faint 20px dot grid; a mouse lights the dots near it and the letters it crosses in the spectrum, the light easing after the pointer. The footer's other look (the site's footer uses the dispersion field's light by default).
items.use_for: A footer or a closing band ending on the wordmark, with the footer's card as its children.
never: The wordmark in a color, or the glow without the pointer: it stays the footer gray
More than once on a page
Moving with reduced motion: the letters keep a still glow
items.source: Site effect/WordmarkGlow (WordmarkGlow.tsx, WordmarkGlow.effect.module.css) and site/Footer/FooterWordmarkGlow: glow radius --footer-glow-radius 260px, centre 0.375 of the width above the word, dots --footer-dot-pitch 20px at white 0.1 fading in over 128px, strength 0.8, the spectrum swept every 90 degrees, masks easing over --dur-footer-glow 450ms on --ease-footer-glow
